---
title: "Core microbiome — healthy corals"
author: "Joana Krause"
date: "2026-08-13"
output: html_document
---

Core microbiome analysis of healthy corals. Core is defined as ASVs with
≥ 0.01% relative abundance (detection) in ≥ 5% of samples (prevalence).
Results visualised as a detection × prevalence heatmap.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 0) Load packages
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(phyloseq)
library(microbiome)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
```

```{r load-ps}
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 1) Load phyloseq object and subset healthy samples
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ps_plas_V3_V4 <- readRDS("../data/ps_final.rds")
# Keep only healthy corals
ps_healthy <- subset_samples(ps_plas_V3_V4, coral_health == "healthy")
ps_healthy
```

```{r relative-abundance}
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 2) Transform to relative abundance (compositional)
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ps_healthy.rel <- microbiome::transform(ps_healthy, "compositional")
ps_healthy.rel
sample_sums(ps_healthy.rel)[1:10]  # Sanity check: each sample should sum to 1
```

```{r prevalence}
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 3) Explore prevalence
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Relative prevalence (fraction of samples)
prev_rel <- prevalence(ps_healthy.rel, detection = 1/100, sort = TRUE)
head(prev_rel)
# Absolute prevalence (number of samples)
prev_counts <- prevalence(ps_healthy.rel, detection = 1/100, sort = TRUE, count = TRUE)
head(prev_counts)
```

```{r core-definition}
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 4) Define the core microbiome
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Core definition used throughout:
#   Detection  ≥ 0.01% relative abundance
#   Prevalence ≥ 5% of samples
pseq.core <- core(ps_healthy.rel,
                  detection  = 0.0001,
                  prevalence = 0.05)
pseq.core
```

```{r core-taxonomy}
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 5) Extract taxonomy of core taxa
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tax.df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(pseq.core))
tax.df$ASV <- rownames(tax.df)
kable(head(tax.df))
```

```{r core-heatmap}
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 6) Core heatmap visualization and export
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Prevalence thresholds (y-axis): 5% to 100% in 5% increments
prevalences <- seq(0.05, 1, 0.05)
# Detection thresholds (x-axis): log-spaced from 0.01% to 20%
detections <- 10^seq(log10(1e-4), log10(0.2), length.out = 10)
# Build the heatmap
p_core <- plot_core(
  ps_healthy.rel,
  plot.type      = "heatmap",
  prevalences    = prevalences,
  detections     = detections,
  min.prevalence = 0.05
) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFFFF", high = "steelblue") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Core microbiome of healthy corals",
    x     = "Detection threshold (relative abundance)",
    y     = "ASVs"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = function(x) label_scientific(digits = 1)(as.numeric(x))
  )
p_core

# Save to PDF
dir.create("../output/core", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
pdf(
  "../output/core/core_heatmap.pdf",
  width  = 3.5,
  height = 5
)
print(p_core)
dev.off()
```
